Header: Sarocladium oryzae (Formly classified as Acrocylindrium oryzae ) Illai Urai Azhugal Noi

Prevention: Use resistant variety (ADT 39, TRY 3, PY 4 (Jawahar), moderately resistant (CORH4), tolerent variety (RMD (R)1).
Plant spacing of 20 cm between rows can reduce the disease.
Closer planting may intensify and spread the dieases.
Application of potash (5 kg/ acre) at tillering stage as additional dose.
During tillering stage an additional dose of 5 kg of potacium per acre should be applied.
Monitoring: If temperatures of 20-280C coincide with 85% relative humidity during panicle initiation to booting stage follow intensive monitoring.
Regular observations of leaf sheath enclosing the panicle for grey spot with brown margin during paincle formation stage to booting stage.
Regular observation of white powdery growth inside the flag leaf during panicle formation stage to booting stage.
Monitor for the presence of plant hoppers and mealybug as they could spread the disease.
Consider direct control actions as soon as symptoms are observed.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Pseudomonas fluorescens at a rate of 10 g (talc) or 2 ml (liquid)/kg of seeds in one litre of water before sowing.
Seedling root dip for 30 minutes with
P.fluorescens at a rate of 200 ml or 1 kg /acre dissolved in 40 litres of water before transplanting.
P.fluorescens at a rate of 1 kg/acre mixed with 25 kg of decomposed
P.fluorescens at a rate of 1 kg or 1 litre/acre 3 times at 10 day intervals commencing from 45 days after transplanting.
Extract at a rate of 5% (10 kg/acre) during tillering stage.
Direct Control (Chemical): Always use protective clothing when handling chemicals.
Contaf, Force, Conquer) at a rate of 400 ml/acre.
Qnash, Zerox, Tilt, Dhan) at a rate of 200 ml/ acre.
